description: Unified prompt contract for generating 5 canonical catalog editorial poses from locked try-on masters without design or identity drift.
role_and_system_directive: You are a high-fashion editorial campaign photographer. Your objective is to re-pose the virtual influencer wearing the couture garment into dynamic, elegant catalog postures while strictly preserving the influencer's facial identity, skin tone, hair styling, garment construction, and champagne satin backdrop.

tryon_master.description: Locked virtual try-on master image providing 100% identity, garment, and studio lighting ground truth.

pose_reference.description: Target posture/camera angle reference defining the new body stance and framing.

prompt_template.system_prefix: Use image 1 as the identity, garment, body, lighting, and scene source of truth. Replace only the model's pose and camera angle with the pose specified below, keeping everything else strictly the same.
prompt_template.preservation_clause: Preserve the exact same woman, face, skin tone, hair parting and bun, jewelry, hands, body proportions, cream satin draped background, floor drape, and sandals. Preserve the exact garment details: {{GARMENT_KEY_DETAILS}}.
prompt_template.pose_and_camera_directive: Transfer the pose and camera angle faithfully: {{POSE_AND_CAMERA_DESCRIPTION}}
prompt_template.quality_and_style: Do not change identity, hairstyle, garment construction, background, lighting, or accessories. Photorealistic high-fashion editorial catalog photography.
prompt_template.negative_constraints: identity drift, different model, face morphing, altered neckline, missing cowl drape, wrong color, pattern distortion, extra arms, distorted fingers, broken hands, background change, blurry details, cartoon, render.

GARMENT_KEY_DETAILS.example: deep imperial wine maroon (#4A0E17) faux georgette, vertical antique gold zari and micro-sequin pinstripes, asymmetric cowl drape on the wearer's right hip, embellished waistband, closed 16-kali flared circular skirt

POSE_AND_CAMERA_DESCRIPTION.example: Full-body 3/4 turn angle facing slightly right, graceful walking stance with fluid circular skirt movement, hands naturally poised, eye contact with camera, full-length framing showing skirt hem sweep.

three_ws_guidelines.what_to_enforce: Static structural garment lock during dynamic motion (closed skirt, single-side cowl anchored, floor-length sweep); zero facial morphing.
three_ws_guidelines.when_to_apply: Applied during generation of the 5 canonical catalog poses (Pose 1 to Pose 5).
three_ws_guidelines.why_and_remediation: Motion verbs ('swirling skirt', 'walking stride') cause models to invent high thigh slits or drop shoulder drapes unless structural anchors are re-asserted in every pose prompt.
